title_format.explanation: The title uses a lowercase type, optional scope/!, and ': '.

summary-section.explanation: The body includes a populated level-two Summary section.

review-coverage.explanation: The review individually addresses every changed file and its implications.

title_meaningful.explanation: The title names a concrete, intelligible change.

title_diff_consistency.explanation: The title agrees with the reference change and patch.

description_present.explanation: The description contains substantive change information.

rationale.explanation: The rationale explains the concrete problem motivating the reference change.

changes_described.explanation: The description states concrete implementation changes.

description_title_consistency.explanation: The description and meaningful title describe the same change.

description_commit_consistency.explanation: The description covers the changes named by every commit.

description_diff_consistency.explanation: The summary covers all substantive changes in the patches.

limitations.explanation: The description names relevant scope limits or risks.

breaking_changes.explanation: The description names the new parameter but not that existing callers must migrate.

testing.explanation: The description gives a relevant validation plan, without claiming execution.

text_diff_triviality.title_explanation: The stated work adds a parameter and one call-site value without stating that the parameter is required or that existing callers must change. Title: chore(client): add a timeout argument to fetch
text_diff_triviality.body_explanation: The stated work adds a parameter and one call-site value without stating that the parameter is required or that existing callers must change. Summary: Add a timeout parameter to fetch() in src/client.py, pass it to _get(), and pass 30 from the call in src/jobs.py.

reference_change.summary: Add a timeout parameter to fetch() in src/client.py, pass it to _get(), and pass 30 from the call in src/jobs.py.
reference_change.rationale: Callers need to choose a timeout for slow endpoints instead of always waiting 30 seconds.
reference_change.limitations: Only fetch() and its call in src/jobs.py are changed; the timeout value is not validated.
